note: Town of Stettler campground at 4621-62 St, directly across from the Rotary Spray Park and West Stettler Pond. No firepits at the sites; portable firepits are allowed on gravelled areas. Washrooms are locked, with a code for registered campers. --Claude
summary: Town page read (browser; curl 403): 66 units, all 30-amp, PWS C$45 / PW C$40 / no service C$20 / overflow C$14, C$10 booking fee, phone reservations only from April 1, season May 1 - Oct 15, free showers + wifi. Base stays C$40 (no-service stalls are listed with tent stalls). Lakeview kept.
flags: WEBSITE: https://www.stettler.net/visit/lions-campground is this campground; curl gets 403, a headless browser gets 200. Phone 403-742-4411 on the page matches the stored phone. Google 'Town of Stettler Campground' 4.1 stars, 84 reviews.

BASE RATE: kept C$40 (power and water). The page lists 'full service, partial service and tent stalls' and a C$20 'No service' rate without saying a motorhome fits those; if the reviewer reads no-service as RV-usable, base would be C$20.
FACILITIES: stored laundry: true (derived) is not mentioned on the page; left alone.

WATERFRONT: keep lakeview. The page says the campground is 'directly across from ... West Stettler Pond'; on imagery the pond's east shore is ~120 m from the NW sites across the street, a tree-lined drainage canal and grass; the rest of the loop is farther. Not waterfront.
